provenance.notes: Synthetic. A secondary rate limit as GitHub documents it: 403 with Retry-After and the secondary-limit message, while the primary limit is not spent. Cannot be provoked on demand without loading GitHub.

response.body: {"message":"You have exceeded a secondary rate limit. Please wait a few minutes before you try again. [remainder of GitHub's message]","documentation_url":"https://docs.github.com/en/rest/using-the-rest-api/rate-limits-for-the-rest-api#about-secondary-rate-limits"}
